info.name: Validate simswap status as true or false.

params.name: customerId
params.description: ID of the subscriber is the MSISDN of the subscriber represented as International  ITU-T E.164.

params.name: senderId
params.description: Identifier of the request originating system, e.g. 'IVR', 'My MTN App'etc.

params.name: startDate
params.description: Start date and end date will be used by 3pp to supply the date range for sim swap (recent) happened on the customer's msisdn, which will be used by operator to validate against the actual sim swap date

params.name: endDate
params.description: Start date and end date will be used by 3pp to supply the date range for sim swap (recent) happened on the customer's msisdn, which will be used by operator to validate against the actual sim swap date

items.docs: Validate  sim-swap status against the last simswap date supplied by the partner  .
